decides: This confirms a Thinkware radar camera as the pick for radar parking, as the question asks. On Thinkware's own table, radar mode (45.2 mA) gives about 6 times the parking hours of motion detection on the same battery. The U3000 Pro's claimed 10% cut matters little: it is $70 more than the U3000 on thinkwarestore.com today ($549.99 vs $479.99), for about 4.5 mA less. The comparison against our DDPAI N5 Dual 2026 + Radar Accessory ($269.00 on store.ddpai.com, read 2026-11-21) cannot be made, because DDPAI's radar current draw was not sourced. A DDPAI place on this angle would need that figure, or it rests on price alone.
